description: Structured output schema for Codex implementation reports. Used with codex exec --output-schema.

status.description: COMPLETE: contract fully implemented and all gates pass. PARTIAL: some contract items done, remainder listed in blockers. BLOCKED: could not proceed; reason in blockers.

summary.description: 2-4 sentences: what was implemented and how. Written for the reviewer, not the user.

changed_files.description: Every file created, modified, or deleted, repo-relative.

gates.description: One entry per gate command listed in the contract. Every gate MUST be run before reporting.

command.description: The exact command that was run.

detail.description: Empty string if passed. If failed: the last relevant error lines.

deviations.description: Every place the implementation deviates from the contract, plus every judgment call, workaround, or spec gap encountered — each with its reason. Deviations are expected and welcome; an empty array on non-trivial work is treated as under-reporting. Include materially better approaches you saw but did not take.

blockers.description: What prevented COMPLETE status, or open questions requiring the reviewer's decision. Empty array when COMPLETE.
